comment: * Builder for {@link MediaItemStatus media item status objects}.

methods.name: public Builder setTimestamp(long elapsedRealtimeTimestamp)
methods.comment:
* Sets the timestamp associated with the status information in
         * milliseconds since boot in the {@link SystemClock#elapsedRealtime} time base.

methods.name: public Builder setPlaybackState(int playbackState)
methods.comment: * Sets the playback state of the media item.

methods.name: public Builder setContentPosition(long positionMilliseconds)
methods.comment:
* Sets the content playback position as a long integer number of milliseconds
         * from the beginning of the content.

methods.name: public Builder setContentDuration(long durationMilliseconds)
methods.comment:
* Sets the total duration of the content to be played as a long integer number
         * of milliseconds.

methods.name: public Builder setExtras(Bundle extras)
methods.comment:
* Sets a bundle of extras for this status object.
         * The extras will be ignored by the media router but they may be used
         * by applications.

methods.name: public MediaItemStatus build()
methods.comment: * Builds the {@link MediaItemStatus media item status object}.
